name: PEPUP Performance
coaAccess: Public product listings say certificates are available, but no report, issuing laboratory, verification code or batch identifier was visible on the listings checked.
dispatchInfo: The shipping policy lists DHL at €6.90 for Germany and €15.00 for other EU countries, with an estimated 2–5 business days within Germany. No dispatch origin or processing time is stated in the shipping policy.

subscore_reasons.labVerification: The shop says a COA is available on several public product pages, but we found no public document, named issuing lab or verification code on the pages checked.
subscore_reasons.fillAccuracy: No report was available to read, so measured net content cannot be assessed; this is the default score for missing data.
subscore_reasons.panelDepth: No analytical methods or test panels could be verified from a report.
subscore_reasons.entityTransparency: The legal notice and terms identify a sole proprietor and a Berlin business address; the shop publishes a VAT ID, but it was not independently verified.
subscore_reasons.dispatchReliability: The shipping policy names a carrier, rates and a domestic delivery estimate, but does not name the dispatch origin, handling time or individual destinations outside Germany.
subscore_reasons.valuePerMg: In our EU audit data, the regular price per mg was above the median for 11 of 13 sampled offers with at least 2 like-for-like EUR comparisons; 1 was at the median to the displayed precision and 1 was below.

strengths: Public research catalog with prices and stock status available without an account
Legal notice identifies the proprietor and a Berlin business address; policy publishes DHL rates and a domestic delivery estimate
weaknesses: COAs are mentioned, but no public reports, issuing laboratory or verification codes were found on the pages checked
The business address is published, but the dispatch origin and processing time are not stated in the shipping policy
verdict: PEPUP Performance publishes its operator details, shipping rates and research catalog. Several listings say a COA is available, but none of the pages checked exposed a report or a code, so we could not verify purity, measured content or the testing panel.
summary: German shop operated by Gökhan Möhürcü as a sole proprietor in Berlin. It has a public research catalog and publishes DHL rates for Germany and other EU countries; no laboratory report could be read on the pages checked.
notes: Cosmetics and accessories are outside this audit. The coded RT-3 listings were not assigned to a named compound because the product page does not specify one. Payment methods are published across different policy pages and were not confirmed at checkout. The shipping policy says Europe-wide and lists an EU rate; the terms discuss non-EU imports but do not identify specific non-EU destinations. The Berlin business address is not evidence of dispatch origin.

auditEvidence.finding: Public dedicated catalog links to the products audited. Product cards show retail prices and are separate from cosmetics or accessories.
The shop page sitemap was checked for a public report or testing page; none was identified.
The public WordPress PDF media filter returned an empty list; this is not proof the shop has no certificates or image uploads elsewhere.
RT-3 10 mg page states a COA is available, but the report, code, issuing lab, lot and named compound were not visible. The listing was not mapped to a compound slug.

The public WooCommerce API supplies stock flags and structured prices for the sampled listings; each retained row is also present on the public research catalog. Stock reflects the read-time listing, not fulfillment.
